Tudor · ref. M79470

Black Bay Pro

GMT · 39mm · 200m (660 ft) · automatic · 2022–2023

The Black Bay Pro is a compact and robust tool watch with a dual time zone feature. It is defined by its 39mm steel case, a satin-brushed fixed 24-hour bezel, and a distinctive yellow 'Snowflake' GMT hand.

The story

The Black Bay Pro was introduced in 2022 as a new branch of the successful Black Bay family. It draws aesthetic inspiration from vintage Tudor tool watches used by explorers, featuring a design geared for professional use. Unlike other Black Bay models that often have rotating dive bezels, the Pro features a fixed steel bezel for its GMT complication. The model launched with the Manufacture Calibre MT5652, a 'true' GMT movement. An opaline dial version was added to the collection, joining the initial matte black dial.
